subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) Soon, he fell in economic difficulty. (b) He went to his friends and relatives for help but none helped him. SSC English (c) He had only one son named Sindbad. (d) At last one of his father's friends helped him to start a business and being successful in it, he became rich again. (e) Long, long ago, there lived a rich man. (f) Sindbad's father died when he was only sixteen. (g) Sindbad having inherited all his father's vast wealth, many of his relatives and friends gathered round Sindbad to look after him. (h) Sindbad, a young and inexperienced boy spent money extravagantly for his relatives and friends. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (c) + (d) + (b) + (e) + (a) + (f) + (h) + (g). Section B : Writing Test
